reading: From each single marker cell, diagonal lines run in all four diagonal directions to the grid border, crossing the background regions; each line cell takes the marker colour that belongs to the region it lies in (each of the two background colours has its own marker colour).

slots.source: the isolated marker cells (one per region colour)
slots.direction: all four diagonals from each marker
slots.stop: grid border (lines pass through region boundaries)
slots.colour: per-cell: the marker colour paired with the background colour of the region the cell lies in

why: every diagonal ray from a marker reaches the border, and each ray cell is recoloured by the region->marker-colour key

reading: The 3x3 input is placed at the top-left of a 6x6 empty canvas and every coloured cell is extended diagonally down-right until the border.

slots.canvas: output is 2x the input size, input placed at top-left

why: each output cell (y,x) equals the input cell (y-k,x-k) for the k bringing it inside the input, else 0

reading: Only the middle column of the grid is kept; every coloured cell outside the middle column becomes background 0.

new_rows.name: off_centre
new_rows.datalog:
gw(max(X)) :- px(Y, X, C).
off_centre(Y, X) :- cell(Y, X, C), gw(W), X2 = X + X, X2 < W.
off_centre(Y, X) :- cell(Y, X, C), gw(W), X2 = X + X, X2 > W.

why: every fg cell not in the centre column becomes 0 (key maps every colour to 0); centre column unchanged

reading: Each 3x3 cup-shaped head (0-coloured bracket with its contents) sits at one end of a long 0 stem; the head block is translated unchanged to the far end of the stem and the stem is erased to background.
verb: slide head to end of stem

slots.subject: the 3x3 box of each head (bracket plus enclosed cells)
slots.path: the straight 0 stem attached to the head
slots.target: the far end of the stem (opposite border), head box ends flush with it
slots.rest: stem and old head cells become background; loose 9 cells untouched

why: each output head box equals the input head box, shifted by the stem length along the stem direction
invariants: cells not on a head or stem

reading: Where two 4s sit on opposite borders of the same row or column, every cell strictly between them is recoloured by the swap 0<->8, 6<->7.

new_rows.name: link
new_rows.datalog:
gw(max(X)) :- px(Y, X, C).
gh(max(Y)) :- px(Y, X, C).
link(Y, X) :- px(Y, X1, C1), C1 = 4, X1 = 0, gw(W), px(Y, W, C2), C2 = 4, px(Y, X, C), X > 0, X < W.
link(Y, X) :- px(Y1, X, C1), C1 = 4, Y1 = 0, gh(H), px(H, X, C2), C2 = 4, px(Y, X, C), Y > 0, Y < H.

why: every cell between two border 4s on one row/column maps 0->8, 8->0, 6->7, 7->6; nothing else changes
invariants: all cells off the linked lines

reading: Around every isolated 1 a fixed plus pattern is stamped: 2 above, 7 left, 6 right, 8 below (clipped at the border).
why: each marker gets an identical 3x3 plus copy centred on it (2 N, 7 W, 6 E, 8 S, 1 centre)

reading: The interior of the 2-coloured rectangular frame is filled with 2, except the bounding box of the 5 cells, which keeps its 0s and 5s.
verb: fill frame except box of inner marks

new_rows.name: frame_minus_box
new_rows.datalog:
osize(O, count(Y, X)) :- obj(O, Y, X).
big(max(N)) :- osize(O, N).
fr(O) :- osize(O, N), big(M), N = M.
frc(Y, X) :- fr(O), obj(O, Y, X).
fy0(min(Y)) :- frc(Y, X).
fy1(max(Y)) :- frc(Y, X).
fx0(min(X)) :- frc(Y, X).
fx1(max(X)) :- frc(Y, X).
inner(Y, X) :- cell(Y, X, C), !frc(Y, X).
iy0(min(Y)) :- inner(Y, X).
iy1(max(Y)) :- inner(Y, X).
ix0(min(X)) :- inner(Y, X).
ix1(max(X)) :- inner(Y, X).
inbox(Y, X) :- px(Y, X, C), iy0(A), iy1(B), ix0(P), ix1(Q), Y >= A, Y <= B, X >= P, X <= Q.
frame_minus_box(Y, X) :- px(Y, X, C), fy0(A), fy1(B), fx0(P), fx1(Q), Y > A, Y < B, X > P, X < Q, !inbox(Y, X).

why: every frame-interior cell outside the 5s' bounding box becomes 2; the box of 5s and everything outside the frame are unchanged
invariants: the 5 cells and the 0s inside their bounding box

reading: The input uses one colour; the output is a fixed 3x3 symbol of 5s chosen by that colour: 1 -> plus, 2 -> T (top row plus centre column), 3 -> corner (right column plus bottom row).

slots.feature: the single fg colour of the input

why: output depends only on the input's fg colour, via a fixed lookup

reading: The input holds 4-cell T shapes of 2 pointing up (apex on top) or down; the output 3x6 counts them: up-pointing T's as 3s in the left 3x3 corners, down-pointing as 1s in the right 3x3 corners, filled in order top-left, bottom-left, top-right, bottom-right.

slots.feature: orientation: apex up vs apex down
slots.output: 3x6 grid; left half corners (0,0),(2,0),(0,2),(2,2) get one 3 per up T; right half corners (0,3),(2,3),(0,5),(2,5) get one 1 per down T

why: number of 3s equals number of up T's and number of 1s equals number of down T's, in fixed slot order

reading: Each grid has a few multi-coloured exemplar shapes; elsewhere a fragment showing only part of one exemplar (e.g. its 4 or its diagonal 8s) is completed into a full copy of that exemplar in the same orientation.

slots.anchors: partial matches: cells that equal a sub-pattern of an exemplar (one colour of it) at some offset
slots.action: paint the missing exemplar cells at that offset

why: every fragment becomes an exact translated copy of the exemplar whose sub-pattern it matches; exemplars unchanged
